market_specific_notes: Houston TRT shoppers usually need a better comparison of candidacy screening, lab cadence, and follow-up process instead of general hormone-optimization branding.
In Houston, the most useful first-screen comparison is how clinics explain monitoring, refill logic, and escalation rules.
local_vetting_points: Ask what labs are required before treatment starts.
Ask how follow-up, dose changes, and refill timing are handled.
Ask what symptoms or lab changes trigger review between visits.
Compare clinics on medical monitoring and escalation rules, not only “low T near me” marketing.
Ask whether care is handled by a qualified clinician and whether treatment goals are documented.
Houston TRT clinic authority framework: compare baseline labs, licensed oversight, monitoring cadence, side-effect planning, fertility/hair considerations, and total cost.
typical_cost_ranges: Clinic pricing in Houston can shift based on lab frequency, visit cadence, medication form, and whether ancillaries are bundled.
A low monthly number is not meaningful without the monitoring schedule.
Authority comes from clearly separating labs, medication, consults, follow-up, and ancillary services.
payment_options: Ask whether labs, follow-up visits, medications, and telehealth check-ins are bundled or billed separately.
Ask whether membership pricing changes after the initial onboarding period.
wait_time_notes: Wait time should be judged by consult speed, lab turnaround, prescription timing, and first follow-up timing together.
Fast onboarding is not the same thing as a good monitoring plan.
availability_notes: Availability should include whether the clinic supports telehealth, weekend labs, refill responsiveness, and mid-cycle questions.
Ask who handles issues between scheduled visits.
named_resources_or_providers: Houston-area independent lab locations, primary-care alternatives, and insurer/lab cash-pay comparison tools are often more useful than branded clinic lists.
Use lab-access and follow-up reality as part of the local comparison.
Local labs, primary care/endocrinology referrals, and clinic credential checks should be part of the comparison.
city_intro_override: Houston TRT and hair-loss shoppers should compare baseline labs, monitoring cadence, clinician credentials, treatment scope, fertility/hair-risk counseling, and total cost before choosing a clinic.

primary_city_decision_block.title: Local TRT and hormone clinic authority checklist
items: Verify baseline labs, repeat-lab cadence, and who reviews abnormal results.
Ask whether the clinic explains fertility, hair-loss, blood pressure, sleep apnea, and hematocrit considerations before treatment.
Compare clinician credentials, escalation rules, and follow-up access rather than relying on low-T marketing claims.
Separate consult fees, labs, medications, refills, follow-up visits, and ancillary services in the quote.
Ask how dose changes, side effects, refill timing, and mid-cycle questions are handled.
Confirm whether hair-loss, peptide, IV, or aesthetic services are optional add-ons or part of a medically monitored plan.

lab_work_notes: Ask what baseline labs are required before treatment starts and how often follow-up labs are expected.
Do not treat same-week onboarding as proof that monitoring is thorough.
Baseline labs and follow-up labs are trust signals; avoid clinics that start treatment without explaining monitoring.
therapy_types_available: Ask whether the clinic handles injections, creams, pellets, or other options and how they decide fit.
The real comparison is screening quality and monitoring, not branding.
monitoring_frequency_notes: Ask when the first follow-up happens, how dose changes are handled, and when symptoms versus labs trigger changes.
Ask whether follow-up cadence changes after stabilization.
fertility_or_hair_considerations: If fertility, hair, or body-composition goals matter, ask how those considerations change the plan before you pay.
Ask about fertility goals, hair-loss risk, sleep apnea, blood pressure, hematocrit, and side-effect management before starting.
